title: Word of Mouth Marketing: All The Basics To Know | Peekage

facts.fact: The page states that 88% of people worldwide said they trust recommendations from friends and family, compared with other kinds of promotion (earned media); the page does not name a source for this figure.
facts.quote: In comparison to other kinds of promotion, 88% of people worldwide indicated they trust recommendations from friends and family (earned media).

facts.fact: The page says the Word-of-Mouth Marketing Association (WOMMA) developed a code of ethics checklist stating that the greatest word-of-mouth marketing strategies are credible, social, repeatable, measurable, and respectful.
facts.quote: the Word-of-Mouth Marketing Association (WOMMA) developed a code of ethics checklist for the sector stating that the greatest word-of-mouth marketing strategies are credible, social, repeatable, measurable, and respectful
